answer.says: Ramesh, I have only one hundred and sixty-six rupees in my pocket. The state's money is tied up in vouchers I cannot spend. I will send the full four thousand the moment the Directorate releases the imprest. Until then, I ask your patience, and I ask you to keep the house in order.
answer.thought: The tension is absolute: my body demands the particular, the immediate sustenance, while my position demands the universal, the orderly administration of funds. I possess the authority of the office but not the means of the purse. Ramesh's obedience is a mirror of the state's function: it holds form even when the content is empty. I must wait for the bureaucracy to fill the vessel before the meal can be served.
